title: A three-spin transfer cell retains its own singlet resource
statement: An arbitrary dirty B with a fresh independent C in I/2 gives singlet success1/4, mean4 preparation measurements; a mixed marginal without independence is insufficient. Given BC singlet, alternate AB measurement and, after failed AB, BC measurement. Successful A-to-C branches are proportional to singlet_AB tensor identity_(A to C), without a corrective rotation. Failure after k AB attempts is(3/4)(5/8)^(k-1), mean3 AB+2 BC measurements. Success leaves AB singlet so reversing ends reuses the cell with mean5 measurements per later transfer, while renewed meters and protected holding are paid. With source cap k_s and transfer cap k_t, L_max=k_s+2k_t-1, ideal failure<=(3/4)^k_s+(3/4)(5/8)^(k_t-1); Delta=L_max epsilon_ST adds physical error and conditional error<=2Delta/(p_ideal-Delta). Source k_s=50,k_t=31 costs up to3266952 probe slots. Exact255-history checks are producer evidence, not an intake replay.

requires: Two selected one-orbital fermion sites, exactly two particles, spin-independent real hopping with g_-I<=G<=g_+I; both double occupations and uniformly bounded offsets retained.
Source bounds, spin-trivial sensor/holding, no spectator couplings, charge-QND sensing, preparation/readout effect bounds and memory-domain/propagator assumptions hold after ALL allowed histories.
Fresh renewed spinless meters; for mixed-spin singlet preparation one fresh independent I/2 spin per attempt, or separately qualified charge-filled-orbital loading with actual uniform rate/caps.

costs: N search plus R return windows; charge detector half-diamond delta_ch<=sqrt(2eta), not merely the classical error eta. Total half-diamond epsilon_ST<=r^N+r^(2N)+1.5(1-p)^R+(N+R)delta_ch.

For the declared favorable source box r<0.6 and p>0.3; epsilon_ST=1e-6 uses75 windows and15975 fresh meter slots. At offset bound d=100 the reported conservative return probability is about1.25e-5; this is no favorable device estimate.

The bounded source/transfer example uses at most111 ideal calls,29432 probe slots each, worst-case3266952 slots, ideal capped failure<=1.131e-6 and conditional successful-output error<5.001e-7 under the stated allocation.

Preparation, renewal, switching, source loading, routed ideal measurement compilation, storage and full duration are paid. Generic symmetry-breaking error contributes integral norm/model-channel error and grows with exposure. Ordinary control on the same source can run the same protocol.
